title: feat: offload URL-shaped chat media
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Offloads large inline data URIs in `image_url.url`, `video_url.url`, and `file.file_url` through one media path.
- Keeps account-scoped content IDs, upload reuse, and the existing 20 MiB per-item memory guard.
- Leaves base64-only `input_audio.data` and `file.file_data` unchanged because those fields require bytes rather than URLs.
- Tests a 48 MiB mixed-media request and repeated chat turns, including URLs forwarded to the provider.
- Gen staging accepted a 33.13 MiB mixed-media request; media metadata confirmed image, video, and file uploads were reused on repeat. Provider support for each URL type remains model-specific.

Addresses #15889. Follow-up to #16199.

gist.headline: Big media takes the side path
gist.blurb: Large images, videos, and files tucked into chat requests take a shared media path. Repeat turns reuse their uploads instead of carrying the same bytes around again.
gist.summary: Chat requests offload large data URIs in image_url.url, video_url.url, and file.file_url through one media path, reusing account-scoped uploads while retaining the 20 MiB per-item memory guard.
gist.impact: Mixed-media chat requests can forward uploaded URLs to providers and reuse those uploads across turns; support for each URL type still depends on the model, and base64-only audio and file-data fields remain unchanged.
gist.visual_concept: Depict a large image, video reel, and document taking a shared garden path from a chat terminal to a reusable media shelf, with Polli guiding them. The shelf represents account-scoped upload reuse; avoid implying every model accepts every media URL.
